root_cause: The line `t.secCnt = t.maxCnt;` does not correctly handle the case when `l.sec < r.max`. This results in `t.secCnt` being assigned a value equal to `t.maxCnt`, which is incorrect. `t.secCnt` should reflect the correct count based on comparisons of `l.sec` and `r.max`.
suggestion: Suggestion 1. Correct assignment based on appropriate variable Modify the line `t.secCnt = t.maxCnt;` to `t.secCnt = r.maxCnt;`. This ensures that `t.secCnt` correctly reflects the count of the second maximum value, which is based on the variable `r.maxCnt` instead of `t.maxCnt`.
